parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-32 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 184.7 | 18.51 | 18.51
2 | 735.3 | 0.77 | 19.28
3 | 503.9 | 2.27 | 21.55
4 | 56.6 | 33.69 | 55.24
5 | 43.3 | 5.90 | 61.14
6 | 520.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-32
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 21.55 – 61.14 m
Recommendation: Drill to a total depth of approximately 65 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity aquifer zone and anchor into the underlying bedrock. Install well screens across the 21.6 to 61.1 m interval to maximize groundwater yield.
